title: Dhoni's Dressing-Room Wisdom Fuels Urvil's IPL History
excerpt: Gujarat batter Urvil Patel smashes a record-equalling 13-ball IPL fifty for CSK, crediting a quiet chat with MS Dhoni for the breakthrough.
body:
On Sunday, May 10, Gujarat batter Urvil Patel walked to the crease at the MA Chidambaram Stadium and proceeded to rewrite IPL history — 13 balls later, he had the joint-fastest fifty the tournament has ever seen. Behind the fireworks was a conversation with a legend.

**What Happened — A Blitz for the Ages:**
Urvil lit up Chepauk with a breathtaking 65 off just 23 deliveries, smashing eight sixes and matching the fastest fifty in IPL history. He shares that record with Yashasvi Jaiswal, who reached his half-century off 13 balls against Kolkata Knight Riders at Eden Gardens in IPL 2023. Urvil also became the first batter in the tournament's history to hit six sixes within the first eight balls of an innings, as CSK chased down a formidable 204-run target to claim five wickets and push into the top five.

**The Dhoni Factor — Clarity Over Doubt:**
After struggling to convert starts in his previous outings, Urvil revealed that a dressing-room interaction with Dhoni — sidelined with a calf injury since the start of the season — helped him regain clarity and confidence. Dhoni's advice, Urvil said, was simple but transformative: 'I don't have any doubt in your skill, whatever doubt is there it is in your mind so just stay clear and try to hit the right ball at the right place.' Dhoni's reassurance removed self-doubt and allowed him to trust his natural attacking instincts.

**Beyond the Record — A Father's Gift:**
After reaching his half-century, Urvil took out a piece of paper from his pocket with the line 'This is for you, Papa' written on it, turning a record-equalling feat into a deeply personal tribute to his father Mukesh Patel. His knock helped CSK pull off their first successful 180-plus chase in the IPL in 15 attempts since 2019.

**What to Watch:**
With Dhoni still recovering from injury, all eyes will be on whether CSK's new power-hitting weapon can sustain this form deep into the IPL 2026 playoff race.
